scope_limits: Observed browser flows are not measured learning, transfer, field performance, usability with people, or complete accessibility conformance.
Initial DOM overflow and axe findings describe the initial state only; runtime events cover the recorded viewport session.
Generic and functional reports rerun initial checks independently and must not be added as independent candidates.
Literal feedback differences/equality are descriptive. Unchanged feedback is not automatically a defect, particularly when the recorded choice/input did not change.
F1/F2 input actions are compared by recorded order, without inferring which feedback paragraph evaluates which input.
No model ratings, reviewer assignment mappings, synthetic outcomes, simulations, or fixture results are used.

notes: Primary journal hash chains verified for 15 of 15 executed runs.
Generation retained 588 accepted responses from 588 requests; 0 were rejected and 0 remain unresolved.
Recorded instruction checks: 0 accepted-response schema violations, 0 prompt-assignment violations, and 0 calls with provenance errors.
Complete provider receipts cover 560 of 588 terminal generation calls. 28 calls have receipt gaps; available totals do not establish complete token or tool-use evidence for those calls.
Separately retained raw event-log copies have discrepancies for 5 runs. Original records are preserved without repair.
Model review retained 26 accepted and 2 failed attempts. Invalid attempts remain unknown; no replacement rating is selected.

figure.alt: Candidate indices and descriptive condition means for human flourishing support, system performance, and learning. The preceding table provides the condition summaries and known counts.
figure.caption: Artifact evidence indices for five flower-aligned configurations. Each point is one generated candidate, averaged across two complete same-model reviews. Diamonds show descriptive condition means. Right-hand counts identify available candidate indices out of three planned repetitions; missing ratings are not treated as zero. AME means Assessment, Measurement, Evaluation. The indices do not measure observed human flourishing, system performance in deployment, or human learning gains.
